questions.prompt: State what is meant by (i) a transverse wave and (ii) a longitudinal wave.
A progressive wave has frequency 5.0 Hz and wavelength 0.80 m. What is its wave speed?
A wave transfers energy horizontally. Its particles oscillate vertically. Which description is correct?

options.A: The wave is transverse because particle displacement is perpendicular to energy transfer.
options.B: The wave is transverse because particles move with the energy.
options.C: The wave is longitudinal because particle displacement is perpendicular to energy transfer.
options.D: The wave is longitudinal because the energy travels horizontally.

questions.prompt: Which statement about a sound wave travelling through still air is correct?

options.A: Air particles travel from the source to the listener.
options.B: Air particles oscillate perpendicular to the direction of energy transfer.
options.C: Air particles oscillate parallel to the direction of energy transfer.
options.D: Air particles remain stationary while only energy moves.
